title: Flag
description: The universal output of every gatekeeper agent. THE contract of this project. INVARIANT: a Flag with no citation does not render. If an agent cannot cite it, it is not a finding.

entity_id.description: Null for findings not tied to a named entity (e.g. a stunt).

severity.description: BLOCKER = cannot shoot or cannot release as written.

category.description: Slug, e.g. trademark_disparagement, sync_license, stunt_pyro, territory_ban.

finding.description: One paragraph, plain English, addressed to a producer.

citations.description: At least one. Enforced, not aspirational.

repaired.description: The desk's excerpt did not appear verbatim in anything this run retrieved, and file_flag replaced it with the aligned span of the source it was transcribing. On the record so a rewritten citation is auditable.

detail.description: Concrete and actionable. 'Rename to a fictional brand', not 'consider alternatives'.

est_cost_usd.description: [low,high]. Industry rule-of-thumb table, NOT a live quote. Label it as such in the UI.

verification_blocked.description: The platform content filter blocked the verification prompt for this finding — deterministic, retries cannot help. Renders as unverified with the filter named.

verification_unavailable.description: True when the verifier could not run and the flag survives fail-open — rendered as unverified, never as verified.

failure_mode.description: Verifier's classification when a flag was rejected — sourcing failures are recoverable once.

resourced.description: True when this flag went through the one-time re-sourcing round.

recoverable.description: On rejected flags: whether the rejection was a sourcing failure eligible for re-sourcing.

cost_excluded_on_target_path.description: Set by the adjudication plan: this flag's remedy cost is moot when the production follows the target-rating path. The flag still renders; the report's target-path cost total excludes it.

fact_reconciled.description: Set when fact propagation restated this finding (and its remedy) against script facts an independent rejection established. The restated text is what renders; the guard manifest carries the trail.

marginal.description: rating_* findings only: the measured CARA descriptor marginal, populated deterministically at filing from the desk's last rating_boundary call — never model-supplied. A rating finding without it does not render (it demotes to open questions and withholds the score).

corpus_n.description: Size of the descriptor corpus the base_rate is computed over (the parsed-rationale subset), so a reader can tell it apart from the comparables corpus.
